content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The FAD's conclusions cannot be traced from documented evidence: only claims A, B8, B15, B17, B22, and C1 receive stated reasons. B17 is described as a rating-change refusal (which matches C1), and the 'all hands' comments attributed to B7 actually appear in B6, so the path from evidence to the conclusion on all 28 incidents is broken."},"rc2":{"status":"gap","note":"Management's reasons (e.g., Complainant 'did not demonstrate at the interview that he was more qualified,' and Colonel 1 and the former supervisor 'agreed' the rating was fair) are stated without attribution to any affidavit, interview panel record, ROI exhibit, or document."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"The alleged incidents carry dates from April 2017 through June 2018, but the record gives no dates for EEO contact, the formal complaint, claim acceptance or amendments, ROI transmittal, or the FAD, and it mentions a 'late filing date' without stating it."},"rc4":{"status":"review","note":"The applicable frameworks (McDonnell Douglas; severe or pervasive) and the 29 C.F.R. § 1614.110(b) FAD route are identified, but the decision-maker is not named and nothing shows that Complainant's rebuttal or pretext evidence (e.g., the B20 alleged admission of retaliatory rating) was weighed."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Because of garbled text, the unexplained 'Caucasian' race/color insertion in B6, mislabeled claim references, unattributed reasons, and most claims left unaddressed, an independent reviewer could not assess from this record whether the no-discrimination conclusion is supported."}}}
